source_method: Official public sources only; no authentication, paid data, CAPTCHA or user-supplied files
tracks: exact identity and indicative parcel geometry

sources.name: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
facts: Full fibre available to 24.9 million UK residential premises (82%)
Gigabit-capable availability 27.1 million homes (89%)
39,000 premises unable to access decent broadband from fixed line or FWA
sources.limitation: National, regional and postcode evidence does not by itself prove orderability or serviceability for an individual parcel.
sources.access_and_licence: Official public Ofcom page and downloadable data; Ofcom terms apply

sources.name: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployments 2026
sources.published_or_updated: Published 13 May 2026; operator plans as of January 2026
facts: Full fibre could reach 28.1 million UK homes (92%) by January 2029
Gigabit-capable coverage could reach 29 million homes (95%)
High-confidence plans require low-level design complete and committed funding
sources.limitation: Forward-looking operator plans are not current availability, completed build or address orderability evidence.
sources.access_and_licence: Official public Ofcom report, tables and methodology annex

facts: Monthly contract-level contracted and built premises reporting
Figures rounded to nearest 10
Variable lag exists between delivery and BDUK data ingestion
sources.limitation: Contract-level delivery totals do not prove that a specific parcel is connected, serviceable or orderable.

facts: Supplier submissions cover existing or planned gigabit infrastructure over three years
BDUK evaluates Gigabit White, Grey, Black and Under Review classifications

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.published_or_updated: Current product page verified 31 July 2026; updated every six weeks
facts: UPRN coordinates for every addressable location across Great Britain
Approximately 40 million addressable locations
CSV and GeoPackage formats
sources.limitation: A UPRN and coordinate identify an addressable location but do not establish broadband availability, title ownership or parcel equivalence.
sources.access_and_licence: Free OS OpenData product; product licence and attribution apply

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers
sources.published_or_updated: Current product page verified 31 July 2026; updated every six weeks
facts: Authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs
CSV look-up table
Can connect address identifiers to roads and topographic objects
sources.limitation: Identifier relationships can support exact joins only where the canonical parcel data contains a trusted matching identifier; they do not provide network service evidence.
sources.access_and_licence: Free OS OpenData product; product licence and attribution apply
